<H1> How the Recycler Crate works <LINE> <TEXT> 1. Every cycle (counted in game minutes), the crate collects the dung from the ground of each linked animal zone in full, whatever its size, from the spot nearest the crate to the farthest: up to %1 items per cycle, and the rest waits for the next one. Only the loaded part of the zones is collected; turn each zone on or off in the crate's menu (Animal zones). <LINE> 2. The map shows only the reach of the composters and storage; arrows on its edge mean a zone continues beyond it, and a zone badge on the edge marks a linked zone that lies outside it. <LINE> 3. The nearest active composter receives the dung and gains compost points; the next one only gets dung when it is full. <LINE> 4. At 10%% or more, an empty sack becomes a compost bag. Sacks in the crate and in storages marked Supplies count; the window shows right away how many were found, and the crate bags within a few seconds when they appear. <LINE> 5. Full bags go to the storages marked Receives, nearest first; the crate is filled last. <LINE> 6. Each composter serves one crate only. Disable it to use it by hand or with another crate. <LINE> 7. The crate only works while its area is loaded; what piles up while you are away is collected when you come back. <LINE> 8. Times are estimates in game time, based on the current herd.
Loose dung around the crate, up to %1 tiles away and outside animal zones (wild rabbits, deer, raccoons, mice, rats...), is collected too. It is not part of the estimates.
Feathers collected from the zones are stored. To turn them into compost, turn on Process feathers into dung in the crate's menu (Feathers): every %1 become 1 cow dung in a composter with room.
Feathers collected from the zones go to the storage marked Receives (or stay in the crate). You can turn this off in the crate's menu (Feathers).

Feathers: what to do with them
Collect and let crates compost them

Feathers pile up in the zones and have little use. With Collect and let crates compost them, the crate collects the feathers, and each crate decides in its own menu (Feathers) whether to process them: processing starts off and, once on, each group of feathers (option below) counts as 1 cow dung when a composter has room. Collecting can also be turned off in the crate's menu.
How many feathers make 1 cow dung when processed. A feather weighs almost nothing, so the default is 100. Feathers are only used when a composter has room, so none are wasted.
